ashmere_green@0.0.1:fact/green_busy.meaning: Someone has come up to the green today.

ashmere_green@0.0.1:fact/lamps_lit.meaning: The green's lamps were lit at dusk.

ashmere_green@0.0.1:fact/bell_up.meaning: The belfry bell has swung up.

ashmere_green@0.0.1:fact/rope_taut.meaning: The bell rope is pulled taut.

text.room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
text.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing below the village.
text.room.village_green.title: Village Green
text.room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass. Lamps hang from its lowest branches, and a squat belfry stands to the east.
text.room.belfry.title: Belfry
text.room.belfry.description: A bell the size of a cart hangs from a beam, its rope wound around a cleat.
text.npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands. He keeps the landing by day and goes up to the green at dusk.
text.npc.maud.room: [Maud] is here, listening to everyone at once.
text.npc.maud.description: Maud knows everything said on the green by evening, and goes down to the landing to say it again.
